defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH received against 100 invoiced (clause 4 under-delivery)
rationale: The goods receipt shows only 60 of 100 EACH delivered (40 on backorder), so under clause 4 the invoice is short-paid on the received quantity: 60 x $9.50 = $570.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3) and no UOM conversion applies. Tax is recomputed on the corrected net at the vendor's 7.5% rate = $42.75, giving $612.75 gross; the supplier's $71.25 simply reflects the over-invoiced quantity, so this is the single quantity defect, not a second tax defect. No credit memos; $612.75 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
